sections.h2: Why regular mowing suits Belconnen blocks
paras: The older suburbs of Aranda, Cook and Macquarie have mature trees and established gardens, and a lawn under that much shade and leaf litter behaves differently from an open block in Holt or Higgins. A fortnightly cut keeps the grass at a steady height, shades out weeds and stops the lawn getting away.

Lawson is the newer end of the district, with smaller blocks and younger lawns that are quick to cut but easy to scalp. Regular lawn mowing Belconnen wide means we know each block and set the mower up to suit it.

Hard frosts from May to August stop most lawns growing across Evatt, Scullin, Hawker and the rest of the district, so we drop to a monthly tidy through winter. From September the spring surge arrives and we move to fortnightly.

Autumn brings heavy leaf drop from the mature deciduous trees in the older streets, and we rake, mow and remove it with the clippings. In summer we cut higher and less often so the lawn holds moisture. Bindi and broadleaf weeds show up from late winter, and our lawn mowing Belconnen customers can add weed spraying before they seed.

faqs.q: How much does mowing cost in Belconnen?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the block, the state of the lawn and what else is included, so we quote each lawn mowing Belconnen job individually. Quotes are free and upfront, and we will not guess a price without seeing the block.

faqs.q: Do you take the grass clippings and green waste away?
faqs.a: Yes, every time. Green waste is removed after every mowing visit, and after garden maintenance and clean-ups too. If you would rather keep some clippings for compost or mulch, tell us and we will leave what you want.
